services.name: Group Tours
services.desc: Dates offered on a first come, first serve basis. Various dates may not be available due to scheduled events, site rentals, and staffing availability. A 50% non-refundable deposit is required upon receipt of your invoice to secure the requested date. The date will not be confirmed until the deposit is received. Deposits may be paid by all major credit cards over the phone or checks mailed to P.O. Box 6228, Leesburg, VA 20178 (payable to the Westmoreland Davis Memorial Foundation). The tour balance is due one week prior to the tour date by check or credit

services.name: Equestrian Facility Rentals
services.desc: The Morven Park International Equestrian Center is a welcoming venue hosting all styles of equestrian competitions! Morven Park is Virginia's premier equestrian venue and a world-renowned horse park with a venerable history where Olympic-level equestrians have competed for decades; steeplechase races have thrilled thousands of fans; and generations of Pony Clubbers have created fond memories.
